about: The engine's art library (R-ASSET-05). Abstract greyscale sources, recoloured to each site's brand and accent hues at build time by engine/tools/lib/art.js. composition: quiet = structure in the end 55-60 %, the start side calm (text may sit there); field = structure across the frame; glow = light only. crop: the sharp position kept when a piece is cropped to another ratio. Generated with OpenAI's image model through the Codex CLI on 2026-10-22 from the shared prompt plus each piece's subject, then reviewed.
model: OpenAI image generation via Codex CLI 0.163.0
prompt: landscape 16:9, as large as the tool allows. Strictly MONOCHROME grayscale: a near-black charcoal background with luminous white and silver structure and soft diffuse light glow; no colour at all (the image will be recoloured to a brand palette later by mapping brightness). Abstract only: no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no people, no hands, no faces, no recognisable products or buildings, no photographs of real places. No film grain, no noise, no dust, no vignette texture. Smooth tonal gradients, crisp fine lines. Premium, restrained, quiet, engineering precision; the feel of a high-end annual report cover or an architecture studio website.

pieces.subject: Fine topographic contour lines flowing like terrain or airflow, concentrated in the RIGHT 55% of the frame with a soft glow behind them; the LEFT 40% is calm, dark and nearly empty because text will sit there.
Fine topographic contour lines like a terrain map seen from above, evenly spread across the whole frame, a few brighter index lines, gentle light pooling in two places.

A single silk-like ribbon made of hundreds of ultra-thin parallel lines, sweeping and twisting in a graceful S-curve through the RIGHT half of the frame, catching light along its folds; LEFT 40% calm, dark and empty for text.
Several ribbons of ultra-thin parallel lines crossing the full frame diagonally, gently twisting, like airflow visualisation in a wind tunnel, light catching the crests.

Architectural vertical fins or louvres in a long repeating row receding in perspective, raking light from the side producing soft gradients on each fin, occupying the RIGHT 60%; LEFT side dark and calm for text. Minimal, like a modern facade detail at night.
Close abstract detail of large smooth folded planes, like sheets of brushed metal or folded paper, meeting at crisp edges, lit softly from above with long gentle gradients; fills the frame.
Concentric thin rings and arcs like an optical lens or radar sweep, centred off the RIGHT edge of the frame, with a soft luminous core; LEFT 40% dark and calm for text.
An infinite perspective grid floor of fine lines receding to a horizon in the right third, a soft dawn-like glow on the horizon, the upper half dark and empty.
Only soft diffuse light: two or three large gentle glows drifting through darkness, like an aurora or light through frosted glass, very low detail, brighter towards the RIGHT; nothing sharp at all.
A field of tiny evenly spaced dots forming a gently undulating wave surface, like a data landscape, dots catching light on the crests, mostly in the RIGHT 60%; LEFT side dark for text.
Fine orthogonal circuit-like traces with 45-degree bends and small round nodes, a few traces glowing softly as if carrying signal, sparse and elegant, denser toward the RIGHT; LEFT 40% nearly empty.
Abstract architectural geometry: overlapping translucent glass-like rectangular planes at slight angles, thin bright edges, layered depth with soft light passing through, filling the frame but calm.
